independent_review.review_scope: Independent read-only design preparation review; not executable live write-plan review or hardware acceptance

findings.title: Whole-namespace protection conflicts with unchanged exporter admission
findings.detail: Step 4 protects the exact namespace and partitions block-RO, then the next section runs the unchanged exporter without an intervening parent-flag transition. scripts/export-known-host-journal.py:167-172 requires the whole DISK BLKROGET/sysfs flag to equal 0; only PART (p4) may be 1. The exporter therefore refuses before its protected mount, independently of journal-directory consistency. This cannot exercise the intended protected inspection lifecycle.
findings.minimum_correction: After authenticating and retaining the immutable off-device dirty archive, require fresh same-device/geometry/idle/consumer revalidation and explicitly restore only /dev/nvme0n1 parent namespace write eligibility to 0 before invoking the unchanged exporter. Keep p4 and p1/p2/p3/p5 block-RO=1, verify all ioctl/sysfs flags, and exclude concurrent administration. Explain that parent eligibility permits privileged raw namespace writes, so exclusion remains essential. Preserve exporter policy unchanged; do not classify this admission refusal as journal-directory evidence.
findings.correction_verified: Corrected design now explicitly requires verified immutable archive, idle identity revalidation, parent namespace RO=0 and all five partitions RO=1 before the unchanged exporter. It identifies premature exporter refusal and forbids weakening preflight or clearing p4 protection. This matches inspect_target and preserves p4 original_ro=1 through protected_journal cleanup.

reviewed_coherent_aspects: The document explicitly states design-only preparation and defers live command bindings, tool availability, actual backups and independent execution review. Their present absence is not a defect.
The active endurance workload is protected by explicit outcome, NVMe health, SD comparison and data/evidence preservation preconditions.
Exact A733 known NVMe identity and p4 geometry bound the deliberate fault; paired restore correctly precedes p4-only dirtiness, and complete original cohort restoration is required on failure.

Only the disposable STATE filesystem is mounted writable for crash creation; protected partitions and no concurrent raw consumers limit accidental writes. SysRq b retains the RAM recovery SD boot route.
RECOVER plus nonzero journal start and raw inode-8 mapping are distinguished from proof of pending committed transactions; absent transaction evidence cannot establish content replay.
Raw dirty archive custody remains separate from the original paired cohort and cannot falsely claim a new three-partition export.
Exporter content refusal can be retained without a false protection failure claim; cleanup and counters still need review before further action.
Production host-init block protection, ro/noload validation, normal unmount, internal-journal/device/idle revalidation and subsequent authorized writable mount are described consistently.

Compatible protected SD restoration, console/identity/marker checks and an actual KVM guest remain physical requirements. No model or loop evidence is promoted to hardware acceptance; final clean boot counts are not claimed.
independent_review.remaining_scope: After the design correction, exact live-bound commands, available tools, actual cohort pins, journal analysis and full reset/normal-boot route still require independent review before execution. No hardware result is established by this report.
independent_review.acceptance: PASS for design preparation only; no live command review, execution authorization binding, exporter hardware validation, dirty-journal replay or physical recovery acceptance is established.
